dataset.name: assistments2009
cleaning_rules: drop rows with an empty skill_id
de-duplicate on (order_id, skill_id), keeping the first occurrence
original is a flag (--original-only), off by default
dataset.label: ASSISTments 2009–2010 skill builder

split.scheme: k-fold by learner, with a validation split of each training fold

control_check.reason: --quick: nazorat soni to‘liq ishga tushirishniki, talabalarning bir qismi bilan solishtirilmaydi

fit.alignment: position 0 of each window has no history and is scored with the training base rate; windows are max_len long with no carry-over; a row whose skill is absent from training is left out of the sequence and scored with the base rate; D57: at prediction a row sees only the answers before its order (the rows of the window's first order are scored with the base rate); training is unchanged

reading.rule: D73: BKT+IRT − DKT farqining 95 % CI pastki chegarasi SECOND_CONDITION_FLOOR dan kichik bo‘lmasa — ikkinchi shart to‘liq o‘qitilgan DKT ga nisbatan ham bajariladi
reading.status: ikkinchi shart to‘liq o‘qitilgan DKT ga nisbatan ham bajariladi
reading.note: H2 ning asosiy hukmi o‘zgarmaydi: u natijadan oldin belgilangan qoida bo‘yicha chiqarilgan (D56, D59). Bu — post-hoc sezgirlik.
